description_en: A reclining armchair with a woven back shell, fabric cushion and folded footrest below the seat; the front shows the tucked footrest panel, the side reveals metal hinge links clad by cane rails, and the rear exposes the pivoted back support inside the woven surround. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
